dedupe_keys.name: sociodemographic data for battery electric vehicle owning households in california

description: Sociodemographic Data for Battery Electric Vehicle Owning Households in California is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This dataset presents results from a survey of 906 FCV and 12,910 BEV households in California. The researcher investigated the sociodemographic profile of FCV buyers and compare them to BEV households. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Transportation, Demography. Its keywords are electric vehicles. The portal shows 2024-06-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
